scope: Uncommitted focused source; 240 known-motion synthetic cases and 72 synthetic-panel real-video controls. No uploaded private video, physical truth or general parity claim.
missing_semantics: None RMS when no measured rows. All-decision RMS includes zero placeholders explicitly as disagreement with truth, never proof of zero motion. No recovery fills the gap.
build: Rust 1.99.1, x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, release thin LTO, one codegen unit; Intel Core i7-6700K/8 logical CPUs, Ubuntu22.04.5. Audit times under development load are not throughput comparisons.

report.gate_note: Diagnostic inaccurate-row threshold .020 rad/component; existing regression gates remain unchanged. Missing rows never count as correct motion. Growing masks reach their target coverage after30 images.

report.scope: Synthetic panels on decoded real video. Identically timed unoccluded replay supplies comparison increments, not physical ground truth. Missing rows stay explicit; no accuracy inferred from acceptance. Growing masks reach their target coverage after30 images.

baseline.scope: Historical matched64 exploratory driver; no all-zero accepted-only RMS is used to infer accuracy. Baseline q6/50 floor10000; loose-control floor18000, otherwise same.

loose-control.scope: Historical matched64 exploratory driver; no all-zero accepted-only RMS is used to infer accuracy. Baseline q6/50 floor10000; loose-control floor18000, otherwise same.

raw_video.scope: Same-video original FicTrac comparison; neither output is physical ground truth. Agreement, acceptance and low image error do not establish motion accuracy.

alignment.method: reference_frame = candidate_frame + explicit offset; no automatic lag selection
alignment.clock_note: Frame identity is asserted by the same-video replay provenance, not inferred from wall-clock timestamps. All reference-clock mismatches, including initial or terminal clock switches, are retained explicitly. Shared video intervals drive derivatives.

gaps.semantics: Frozen all-frame deltas/paths are missing measurements. Relocalization publishes no hidden motion. Original .dat has no validity flag.

trajectory_all_common_rows.alignment: Only initial position and heading; no later fitting, scaling or gap reconstruction.

rolling_comparison.note: Every available overlapping window includes all candidate decisions, including frozen missing-motion rows.

motion_structure.clock: Both derivatives use the validated candidate video presentation intervals. Candidate excludes every unmeasured delta; acceleration never spans a missing interval.

native.scope: Complete calibration-only native file replay; numeric recording; no wire/video outputs; source pacing off. Timings are loaded validation, not throughput claims.

interval_trajectory.note: Only the initial position and heading are aligned; no later time-dependent rotation, scaling, trajectory fitting or gap reconstruction is applied. These drift metrics are reported independently of increment gates.

rolling_healthy_100_image_rotation.note: Every overlapping 100-image clear pre-hand window with consecutive source IDs is checked, including unaccepted candidate decisions. common_healthy_100_image_windows.note: Diagnostics on fixed non-overlapping windows with 100 common, consecutively captured, tracked images. Translation removes starting path offset; heading alignment additionally rotates the candidate path by its starting heading discrepancy. These metrics do not replace all-frame gates or global path drift.

fresh_suffix_control.note: Same decoded images, independently initialized atlas. Agreement tests recovered increments; it is not physical ground truth.

quorum-vr3.path_heading_note: Pre-hand path/heading drift is reported, with no long-sequence parity claim. The source recording skips capture images; source timestamps are not video timestamps.
